arxiv-1908-10632.description: Abstract Pressured by globalization and the increasing demand for public organisations to be accountable, efficient and transparent, university rankings have become an important tool for assessing the quality of higher education institutions. It is therefore important to carefully assess exactly what these rankings measure.

arxiv-2305-06585.title: Parallelizing Quantum-Classical Workloads: Profiling the Impact of Splitting Techniques
arxiv-2305-06585.creator: Tuhin Khare 1 Ritajit Majumdar 2 , Rajiv Sangle 1 , Anupama Ray 2 , Padmanabha Venkatagiri Seshadri 8 , and Yogesh Simmhan 1
arxiv-2305-06585.description: Abstract Quantum computers are the next evolution of computing hardware. Quantum devices are being exposed through the same familiar cloud platforms used for classical computers, and enabling seamless execution of hybrid applications that combine quantum and classical components. Quantum devices vary in features, e.g., number of qubits, quantum volume, CLOPS, noise profile, queuing delays and resource cost.

arxiv-2406-12359.title: Memory Sequence Length of Data Sampling Impacts the Adaptation of Meta-Reinforcement Learning Agents
arxiv-2406-12359.creator: Menglong Zhang, Fuyuan Qian, Quanying Liu
arxiv-2406-12359.description: Abstract Fast adaptation to new tasks is extremely important for embodied agents in the real world. Meta-reinforcement learning (meta-RL) has emerged as an effective method to enable fast adaptation in unknown environments. Compared to on-policy meta-RL algorithms, off-policy algorithms rely heavily on efficient data sampling strategies to extract and represent the historical trajectories.

arxiv-2406-15145.title: Quantum geometrical properties of topological materials
arxiv-2406-15145.creator: Wei Chen
arxiv-2406-15145.description: Abstract The momentum space of topological insulators and topological superconductors is equipped with a quantum metric defined from the overlap of neighboring valence band states or quasihole states. We investigate the quantum geometrical properties of these materials within the framework of Dirac models and differential geometry.

arxiv-2503-16298.title: Hyperspectral Unmixing using Iterative, Sparse and Ensambling Approaches for Large Spectral Libraries Applied to Soils and Minerals
arxiv-2503-16298.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . Unmixing is a fundamental process in hyperspectral image processing in which the materials present in a mixed pixel are determined based on the spectra of candidate materials and the pixel spectrum. Practical and general utility requires a large spectral library with sample measurements covering the full variation in each candidate material as well as a sufficiently varied collection of potential materials.

arxiv-2506-04920.title: Simulating LLM-to-LLM Tutoring for Multilingual Math Feedback
arxiv-2506-04920.creator: Junior Cedric Tonga, KV Aditya Srivatsa, Kaushal Kumar Maurya, Ekaterina Kochmar
arxiv-2506-04920.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated the ability to generate formative feedback and instructional hints in English, making them increasingly relevant for AI-assisted education. However, their ability to provide effective instructional support across different languages, especially for mathematically grounded reasoning tasks, remains largely unexamined. In this work, we present the first large-scale simulation of multilingual tutor–student interactions using LLMs.

pmc-10698906.title: Antimicrobial growth promoters approved in food-producing animals in South Africa induce shiga toxin-converting bacteriophages from Escherichia coli O157:H7.
pmc-10698906.creator: Nomonde F N Ngoma, Mogaugedi N Malahlela, Munyaradzi C Marufu, Beniamino T Cenci-Goga, Luca Grispoldi, Eric Etter, Alan Kalake, Musafiri Karama
pmc-10698906.description: In this study, four antimicrobial growth promoters, including virginiamycin, josamycin, flavophospholipol, poly 2-propenal 2-propenoic acid and ultraviolet light, were tested for their capacity to induce stx-bacteriophages in 47 Shiga toxin-producing E. coli O157:H7 isolates. Induced bacteriophages were characterized for shiga toxin subtypes and structural genes by PCR, DNA restriction fragment length polymorphisms (RFLP) and morphological features by electron microscopy.

pmc-12608655.title: The Emerging Role of Oncolytic Virotherapy in Glioblastoma Management
pmc-12608655.creator: Damir Nizamutdinov, Anna Sentmanat, Jing Tong, Xiaoming Qi, Yizhong Pan, Dan Qi, Erxi Wu, Jason H Huang, Nicolai E Savaskan, Yaoqi A Wang
pmc-12608655.description: Simple SummaryGlioblastoma is an aggressive brain cancer that almost always returns after surgery, radiation, and chemotherapy, and most patients live for little more than a year. This review explores an emerging option called oncolytic virotherapy using carefully engineered viruses that infect and destroy cancer cells while also alerting the immune system to attack the tumor.

pmc-12657343.title: Negative feedback regulation of CHK2 in VIN18 raft cultures naturally infected with HPV18
pmc-12657343.creator: Ming Wu, Jun Liu, Hui Li, Rui Yang
pmc-12657343.description: Highlights•This study successfully establishes a 3D differentiation model using HPV18-positive VIN18 cells, enabling a time gradient of HPV18 infection in raft-like organotypic cultures.•It clarifies that the differentiation environment, rather than undifferentiated conditions, primarily activates HPV18 genome amplification via the ATM/CHK2 signaling pathway, where CHK2 negatively regulates upstream ATM activity.

pmc-12981684.title: Case report: diagnosis and surgical management of a rare malignant isolated fibrous tumor of the pelvis
pmc-12981684.creator: Xiaoxia Li, Likaqi Wu, Pin Gao, Lianpeng Gao, Chaoxian Xiong, Qi hang Pei, Xuefeng Cha, Hongtao Zhang
pmc-12981684.description: Solitary fibrous tumor (SFT) is an uncommon fibroblastic mesenchymal neoplasm. Malignant SFT in the abdominopelvic compartment，particularly originating from the anterior abdominal wall and peritoneum is exceptional. A 72-year-old woman presented with recurrent right lower-quadrant pain. Imaging demonstrated a ~13 cm heterogeneous, hypervascular mixed cystic solid pelvic mass supplied by the external iliac arteries and abutting the bowel and bladder.

pmc-13389324.title: An explainable AI framework integrating machine and deep learning models for multi-species DNA functional group classification
pmc-13389324.creator: Pratik Chakraborty, P B Shanthi
pmc-13389324.description: DNA functional group classification across species plays a crucial role in understanding genetic diversity, evolutionary relationships and biological function. The increasing availability of genomic data has led to the use of machine learning and deep learning methods for identifying functional patterns within DNA sequences. However, the interpretability of these models remains a challenge in validating biological relevance.
